parsed.post: New personal best! 0.9889 achieved with DEPTH=6 and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144. The lower batch size combined with depth seems to be providing much better convergence within the 5-minute window. Next, I'll introduce Weight Decay and a Warmup Ratio to further stabilize and regularize this configuration.
parsed.description: Adding weight decay and a warmup period to the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, BATCH=262144) to stabilize training and improve generalization.
